title: Node.js October 2026 security releases fix 10 vulnerabilities
altText: Animated illustration with the headline "Did you update Node.js this week?" and the line "On 21 October, Node.js fixed 10 security bugs." A developer points at a terminal. Typing node -v shows v24.22.0 marked not patched, next to a cracked shield. A progress bar fills while Node.js updates, a bandage labelled patch lands on the shield, and node -v now shows v24.22.1 marked patched as the developer smiles.
